meta.title: Epilepsy | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Supporting seizure management and safe, independent daily living.

overview: Epilepsy causes recurrent seizures that vary widely in type, severity and impact on daily life.

At Cambridge Hospital, we provide comprehensive assessment, medication review and lifestyle guidance for adults and children. Families receive seizure-management education, safety planning and rehabilitation support for any cognitive or physical effects after episodes. For school-aged children, in-school therapy coordination ensures safe and confident participation in the classroom.
